key_claims: Big Agnes lightweight bike packing tents cost approximately 400 euros
MSR camp stove can boil a litre of water in roughly 5 minutes
Handlebar bags should contain bulky items like tent, mat, and sleeping bag
Frame bags should carry dead weight (food, spares, towels) close to the frame to avoid affecting center of gravity
Wicklow Way huts are spaced for 5-7 day hiking routes, making them fall at awkward distances for a 2-day bike packing trip
specific_numbers: 5 minutes to boil 1 litre of water with MSR stove
5-7 day hiking duration on Wicklow Way
10 minutes for dehydrated camp food to rehydrate
cluster_reasoning: This is a practical adventure-cycling how-to episode focused on bikepacking gear and logistics, which falls squarely under cycling culture and the broader adventure-cycling movement rather than training methodology, nutrition, or performance science.
